headline: Srei Venture Capital Trust Infrastructure Project Development Capital files substantial acquisition disclosure in Bharat Road Network Limited
sum: Srei Venture Capital Trust Infrastructure Project Development Capital has filed a Regulation 31(4) substantial acquisition disclosure with the NSE in respect of Bharat Road Network Limited, signalling a material shareholding event in the infrastructure roads company.
implication: A substantial acquisition disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations Reg. 31(4) triggers public disclosure of acquiring party's shareholding threshold (typically 5%+ slab); review whether this crosses into mandatory open offer territory under Reg. 4 or exemptions under Reg. 5.
detail: Srei Venture Capital Trust Infrastructure Project Development Capital (a trust vehicle) has submitted a formal disclosure to the NSE under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI Takeover Regulations 2011 in respect of Bharat Road Network Limited (BRNL), a company operating in the road infrastructure sector. The disclosure indicates a crossing of shareholding thresholds that require public announcement. The exact shareholding percentage and acquisition consideration are not disclosed in the headline material, but the filing date and regulatory framework confirm this is an announced, material acquisition event subject to takeover code compliance.
